contents.text: From October 31st - 31st 12025, the alias of major SD5 Updates will be a reference to the date they publicised
Weather now influences the temperature and stuff
Added functionality for the Gear Station, accepting many custom Items (no Vanilla ones!)
Soul Sand equipment is now upgraded from Netherrack equipment in the Gear Station
Prismaridian equipment is now upgraded from Prismarine equipment in the Gear Station
Added Wartrack Armour as a Netherrack Upgrade using the Gear Station
Added the Sword of Agaminor using the Gear Station
Added the Advanced Pick using the Gear Station
Added a few components used in the Upgrading processes
Unfortunately, all previously crafted equipment cannot be recognised by the Gear Station and has to be re-crafted :(
Tungsten: Skylight is now measured at eye level instead of feet, and Tungsten's code is more compact

Fixed Bugs:
Underground classification was broken (resulting in a ... survivable cave experience ...)
